digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage logging and telemetry
propositions: Gate run telemetry computes loop-vs-breadth signal via tool-call distinct-ratio but discards it at write, making the same budget-tuning question unanswerable without re-running instrumented copies.
The success path never computes tool-call counts, so successful runs cannot be used as control groups for cost comparison against failures.
Gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing at all, forcing operators to set env vars or run outside the normal gate lifecycle to capture metrics.

The wiring is incomplete: failure_usage() reduces the full shape but record() builds its row from _FIELDS allowlist alone, dropping tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, and finish_reason one frame from write.
